profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ One Inc | Certified Azure AI Engineer
profile.summary:
At Apex Fintech Solutions, my focus is on fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning within our software engineering teams. The recent months have been pivotal, as we've integrated AI capabilities and upheld industry standards to propel our financial technology services to new heights. My tenure at Luminex Corporation, where I developed the Luminex INTELLIFLEX system, imbued me with a profound appreciation for interdisciplinary collaboration and global team coordination.

The journey through sectors such as Life Sciences, Industrial Automation, and Retail Marketing has honed my adaptability and enriched my leadership approach. With a Certified ScrumMaster® credential and recent Microsoft certifications in Azure AI, I am poised to navigate our team through the intricacies of software solutions engineering, always with an eye towards skill development and technological excellence.

projects.title: INTELLIFLEX System
projects.description: Oversight of multidisciplinary team of over 20 software developers, designers, testers, business analysts and technical writers to develop new software for the INTELLIFLEX System. The software was a greenfield project built with .NET Core, WPF, ASP.Net and SQL Server.

projects.title: Lands of America Redesign
projects.description: Successfully led team of 20 developers and testers in creating a new Lands Of America site (https://www.land.com/) from ground up while also maintaining the existing Land.com digital platforms. Worked with team, product managers and executive management to set strategic deployment of large projects. Led the consolidation of teams and products as part of a merger between two previously competing websites.
